The Seminole receipts

  • A Florida law signed May 17, 2023 (SB 254) bans gender-affirming prescriptions and procedures for anyone under 18. The only exception: some teens whose prescriptions started before the law took effect.

    Source: Florida Senate

  • Since July 1, 2023, another state law (HB 1069) has set rules on titles and pronouns in public schools and widened the process for objecting to school books and materials.

    Source: Florida Senate

  • In August 2025, the Florida Department of Transportation removed the rainbow crosswalk outside the Pulse memorial in Orlando overnight. Orlando’s mayor said the city wasn’t told beforehand.

    Source: CBS12 / Sinclair syndicated report on WJLA
